info.title: Event Management API
info.description: Complete API documentation for the event management system with authentication, events, registrations, and staff management.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Authentication endpoints with Keycloak integration and session management.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Core endpoints for managing events with file upload support.

tags.name: Event Registrations
tags.description: Endpoints for user event registration, check-ins, and attendance management.

tags.name: Event Staff
tags.description: Endpoints for applying and managing event staff.

tags.name: Event Forms
tags.description: Endpoints for managing event feedback forms, form fields, and submissions.

get.description: Redirects the user to the Keycloak login page for authentication.
Returns the Keycloak login URL without redirecting.
Handles the OAuth callback from Keycloak and creates a session.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Error from Keycloak if authentication failed

get.description: Validates the current session cookie and returns session information.
Logs out the user, clears the session, and redirects to Keycloak logout.
Returns the Keycloak logout URL without logging out.
Returns information about the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new event with optional file uploads for thumbnail and images.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all events.

get.summary: Get a single event by ID (Public)

patch.description: Updates an existing event with optional file uploads.

post.summary: Register current user for an event

delete.summary: Unregister current user from an event

get.description: Returns all event registrations for the current user.

delete.summary: Cancel a registration by ID (Admin only)

get.description: Returns all registrations for an event, optionally filtered by status.
Returns all pending registrations for an event waiting for approval.

patch.description: Approves a pending registration, allowing the user to attend the event.
Rejects a registration, preventing the user from attending the event.

patch.summary: Change attended status (Check-in) by Registration ID (Admin only)
Change attended status (Check-in) by User ID

patch.description: Marks a user as attended for an event.

post.summary: Apply to be staff for an event

get.description: Returns all staff applications for the current user.

get.summary: Get all staff applications for an event (Admin/Organizer only)

post.summary: Add a user as staff (Admin/Organizer only)

patch.summary: Approve or Refuse a staff application (Admin/Organizer only)

post.summary: Create a new form for an event
post.description: Creates a feedback/survey form for an event. Each event can only have one form.

get.summary: Get the form for an event
get.description: Returns the form associated with an event, or null if no form exists.

200.description: Returns the event form or null

get.summary: Get a specific form by ID

post.summary: Add fields to a form (supports single or bulk)
post.description: You can send a single field object or an array of field objects to add multiple fields at once.

400.description: Invalid field data (e.g., CHECKBOX/RADIO without options)
Form not active or required fields missing

get.summary: Get my submission for this form
Get all submissions for a form (organizers only)
Get a specific submission by ID

get.description: Returns statistics including total submissions, answer distributions for each field, and average ratings.

fields.description: Initial form fields to create with the form

question.example: How satisfied are you with the event?
